relationship_description: Suharto Mangudadatu is the brother of Esmael 'Toto' Mangudadatu, both prominent members of the Mangudadatu political dynasty in Sultan Kudarat and Maguindanao.
Suharto Mangudadatu is the son of Datu Pax Mangudadatu, patriarch of the Mangudadatu political dynasty in Sultan Kudarat.
Suharto Mangudadatu is the brother of Zajid Mangudadatu, both serving in various government positions in Sultan Kudarat and Maguindanao.
